page.overview:
What is Spirit Daggers?

Spirit Daggers are daggers used by Nightwolf in Mortal Kombat (2011) and again in Mortal Kombat 11.

Spirit Daggers are summoned by Nightwolf in a similar manner to his Bow and Arrow and his Tomahawks. He utilizes them in combat as alternate close range weapons with his tomahawks, swapping to them for quick offense while utilizing his tomahawks for heavy hitting attacks.
